SpecialTraits.Thorn Warden: Difficult terrain made of plants doesn't cost the hag extra movement.

Actions.Multiattack: The hag makes two Thorn Lash attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.
Actions.Thorn Lash: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
Actions.Thorn Dart: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing damage.
Actions.Bramble Burst (Recharge 5–6): Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (6d8) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the start of the hag's next turn. Success: Half damage only.
Actions.Spellcasting:
The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):
At Will: Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion
1/Day Each: Entangle, Hold Person, Plant Growth, Thornward Hex

BonusActions.Misty Step (2/Day): The hag casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Reactions.Bramble Shield: Trigger: The hag is hit by an attack roll. Response: The hag adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

LegendaryTraits.Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Options.Lash: The hag makes one Thorn Lash attack.
Options.Grasping Roots: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the hag can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The hag can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Notes: Authored test fixture in 2024 statblock wording (not from a published book). Built to exercise: 'Melee/Ranged Attack Roll: +N' attacks; 'Dexterity Saving Throw: DC N ... Failure/Success' saves; a Cone area; 'Recharge 5–6' with an en dash; Spellcasting as an action with At Will and 1/Day Each lists and no slots; an X/Day bonus-action spell (Misty Step); a Trigger/Response reaction; 2024 Legendary Resistance wording; and one spell not in the SRD table (Thornward Hex), which must be marked unknown.
